name: 73107 · Oklahoma City, OK
findings: ZIP 73107 (Oklahoma City) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73107 (Oklahoma City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 73107 (Oklahoma City) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).
